violated_contract: A prompt-cache breakpoint must sit after a prefix that is byte-identical across calls that differ only in per-call inputs. Putting a timestamp, timezone, language, transcript, or other per-call value at or before that boundary means every call writes a unique prefix and no later call can read it.
canonical_prevention: Hoist only static instruction text into the marked prefix; move dates, transcripts, and other per-call values after the breakpoint; pin the split with a regression test that two invocations with different per-call inputs produce byte-identical prefix bytes.
